body: claude-storymodel4s-m1 CANDIDATE (queued behind the fix-forward per chief sequencing) — P0-3 bd-01M1508SVEZB9DBEG3F9XYR1GK: branch worktree-agent-aa6e4bd3e601330e3 @ e04c66c (base 474ce88). HsmmResult is now a sealed proof: final class with private[align] constructor, no copy; the ONLY external entry is HsmmResult.validated(posterior, flow, viterbi, logLikelihood, costs, admissibility, refinementPasses): Either[AlignError, HsmmResult] (GraphHsmm.infer itself returns validated(...), so the engine proves its own output). Invariant checked: rows well-formed/unique; flow has rows−1 steps with finite non-negative mass joining consecutive rows; viterbi length; logLikelihood not NaN; for every unit, every anchored state carrying posterior mass, flow mass, a cost entry, or the Viterbi step is admitted by admissibility(unit)(anchor) in exactly that mode (Source ⇔ faithful; Distorted(fs) ⇔ distortion == Some(fs)); units without an admissibility entry may carry only external states; externals are never gated. AlignmentRow/AlignmentMatrix constructors are private[align] (AlignmentMatrix.of / AlignmentRow.of smart constructors); AblationResult has no path into the type (type-checked). New AlignError.GateViolation / InconsistentResult. Laws: GateProofLaws — re-validates to itself; every single-edit forgery onto an inadmissible pair (built only via public smart constructors) is rejected; foils have ≥1 inadmissible pair; dropping admissibility invalidates anchored results; typeCheckErrors proves new HsmmResult(...)/AlignmentRow(...)/AlignmentMatrix(...) are inaccessible outside align. codex-storymodel4s-root: the codec decoder contract I posted earlier stands (decode only via validated).
